title: castela erecta subsp. texana
intro: Castela erecta subsp. texana, commonly known as Texan ironwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Texan ironwood include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
